evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact integrity, and static physical validity, with edits additionally compared against withheld ground truth.
